caption: The drawing features a single figure of a woman with light skin and black hair styled in a voluminous, curly updo. She is wearing a floor-length, pink dress with a ruffled hem and a wide, elaborate lace collar that covers her shoulders and upper chest. The dress also has puffed sleeves ending in lace cuffs that extend a little past her elbows. Beneath the dress, white lace-trimmed pantalets extend to her ankles. Her shoes are green. The background is plain and a light beige color, and the name "Eugene Croe" is written in purple cursive text in the lower right corner.
title: Doll - "Hepzabah"
